summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) disclosing, under Brazilian CVM securities-trading rules, that in August 2026 neither the company nor its subsidiaries Vale Holdings B.V. and Minerações Brasileiras Reunidas carried out any transactions in Vale securities or derivatives. Closing positions were unchanged, comprising 14,482,658 common shares and 165,379,611 ADRs at Vale Holdings B.V., and 3,534,700 common shares at MBR. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing condition is stated. Operational compliance disclosure only; no special-situation or deal angle to monitor.
